description: This file defines a composable function 'useFileApi' for handling file uploads, updates, and imports in a Vue 3 project. It includes methods for creating/updating user files, updating recipe images, performing AI-based imports, and app imports, utilizing fetch API calls to backend endpoints.

methods.name: createOrUpdateUserFile
methods.description: Creates or updates a UserFile object on the server, optionally updating if an ID is provided.

methods.name: updateRecipeImage
methods.description: Updates or deletes a recipe's image by uploading a file or specifying an image URL.

methods.name: doAiImport
methods.description: Uploads a file for AI-based image recognition and imports recipe data.

methods.name: doAppImport
methods.description: Uploads multiple files to import recipes, meal plans, shopping lists, and nutrition info.
